name: The Garfield Show
description: Your favorite lazy, fat cat is at it again. Garfield, Odie, Jon and the rest of the gang are back for more funny misadventures. Whether he's scarfing down lasagna or tricking Nermal the kitten, Garfield is guaranteed to crack you up. But remember: He hates Mondays!

videos.title: Rodent Rebellion
videos.overview: Criminal mastermind Ratzo leads the rodents in a series of robberies. When the police discover the hidden loot in the basement, Jon Arbuckle gets the blame. Garfield must stop ratting around and seek help from the legend of the Pied Piper in order to clear Jon's name!

videos.title: Pasta Wars
videos.overview: It's Garfield's birthday and Jon forgets. He later remembers, and makes 8 lasagnas but is one short. Meanwhile, an unusual type of Alien which looks like lasagna and can speak English with an Italian accent arrives on Earth. They plan to invade the Earth, but are quickly scared away by Garfield's ravenous appetite.

videos.title: Mother Garfield
videos.overview: A Bluebird gets trapped in Garfield's neighbor's garage leaving her eggs abandoned, forcing Garfield to look after them. The eggs hatch, and call Garfield mother. This episode marks the first appearance of Garfield's rival Harry, who is determined to eat the chicks.

videos.title: Orange and Black
videos.overview: Garfield disguises himself as "Catzilla" for Halloween, but people mistake him for the real Catzilla, a deadly creature who escaped from the zoo.

videos.title: Freaky Monday
videos.overview: Garfield and Odie get their bodies swapped by a Saturnian alien when it finds out Odie is tormented by Garfield. Odie wanders off to all the people who hate Garfield without knowing they will hurt him so Garfield must protect his body from the neighborhood dogs, Herman Post and the Chef.

videos.title: Bone Diggers
videos.overview: Odie digs up some bones and finds that they are from the very rare Brachiosaurus. Garfield tries to sell them to the local museum, but the museum curator instead wants to compulsory purchase and demolish Jon's house to search for more dinosaur bones.

videos.title: The Robot
videos.overview: Jon tests a cleaning robot.

videos.title: Cat Nap
videos.overview: Garfield and Odie watch a movie about a villain named Silent Jack and mistakenly believe Jon, with recent tooth surgery, to be Silent Jack. In the end Garfield, Odie and Squeak find out they were attacking Jon, but the real Silent Jack robs them.

videos.title: Agent X
videos.overview: Nermal finds a cat called "Agent X" who claims to be a Secret Agent, but really a runaway cat. Garfield becomes jealous as Agent X tells everyone about his adventures, so Garfield tries to prove he is a house cat named "Fluffykins".

videos.title: A Game of Cat and Mouse
videos.overview: Squeak and his family move in to Jon's house while Jon and Odie are out. Garfield allows Squeak's family to remain in the house on the condition that they be his servants. Jon comes back and Garfield has to remove Squeak and his family before Jon called Rat-Tator Pest, who's hefty bill would have meant that Jon would not be able to afford lasagna for years.

videos.title: Perfect Pizza
videos.overview: Garfield gets an awful tasting Pizza from Mama Meany's Pizza Palace, Vito's rival. Mama Meany is putting Vito out of business through coupons, contests and discounts and plans to expand the restaurant to take over Vito's. Garfield arranges for Eddie Gourmand to compare Mama Meany pizza with Vito's, bringing the closure of Mama Meany, and resumed success of Vito.

videos.title: King Nermal
videos.overview: Nermal lives with Garfield for 10 days because his owner is out of town. Nermal fakes a leg injury and Jon feels pity for Nermal, making Garfield and Odie do whatever he requests. Garfield and Odie get rid of him so they could enjoy their normal house and lives once again.

videos.title: Desperately Seeking Pooky
videos.overview: Garfield searches for his teddy bear Pooky after he is stolen by a dog named Hercules.

videos.title: High Scale
videos.overview: Jon and Liz put Garfield on a diet and force him to exercise when an electronic talking scale tells him that he's overweight.

videos.title: Jon's Night Out
videos.overview: Jon has difficulty sleeping, so a Hypnotist attempts to put Jon under hypnosis to make him fall asleep at the sound of a horn. However, Jon hears Odie's bark before the horn, making Odie the hypnosis trigger.

videos.title: Not So Sweet Sound of Music
videos.overview: Jon finds his old Accordion but Garfield doesn't like him playing it nor the very sound of it. Garfield tries to get rid of it, but in the end, the Accordion breaks and Jon gets bagpipes instead.

videos.title: Turkey Trouble
videos.overview: Jon wins a turkey in a competition, which he plans to cook for Liz. However, when it is delivered it is still alive. Garfield disguises himself as a turkey to get rid of the real one.

videos.title: Pup in the Pound
videos.overview: Odie gets taken to the dog pound as he's not wearing his license tag Collar. Garfield disguises himself as a dog to rescue Odie.

videos.title: Odie in Love
videos.overview: Odie falls in love with a shower brush. Garfield gets jealous as Odie is no longer paying attention to him and throws the brush in the recycling bin without Odie knowing it.

videos.title: Pet Matchers
videos.overview: Jon and Garfield fight so much against what to watch on TV that they decide to go on a TV show called Pet Matchers.

videos.title: Lucky Charm
videos.overview: Garfield gets rich after a Leprechaun gives him some good luck.

videos.title: Curse of the Were-Dog
videos.overview: Odie becomes a monster-dog in the middle of the night and eats a lasagna that was for for Jon and Liz. Jon thinks that Garfield is responsible, and blames him.

videos.title: Meet the Parents
videos.overview: Liz introduces Jon to her parents. Liz's father is a grumpy man, while Liz's mother has a canary named Petey - who Garfield tries to eat.

videos.title: Down on the Farm
videos.overview: Garfield goes to visit Jon's little brother Doc Boy. But with no TV and no pizza, Garfield shows the farm animals how to live life his way.

videos.title: The Pet Show
videos.overview: Garfield is rejected from The Pet Show because he's too fat to enter, so Odie takes his place and competes against Nermal for lasagna.

videos.title: Curse of the Cat People
videos.overview: Garfield and Odie get taken to another land through a magic mirror where Neferkitty (voiced by Susan Silo) and her Egyptian colony of cats live, planning their revenge on humans.

videos.title: Glenda and Odessa
videos.overview: Garfield and Odie are mistakenly accused of stealing barbecued ribs (really stolen by neighborhood pets) when they run away from Jon's twin girl cousins.

videos.title: Underwater World
videos.overview: Garfield and Odie discover talking fish in the sea.

videos.title: Family Picture
videos.overview: Jon tries to take the "perfect family picture" for Liz's birthday present but people always come and disturb everything.

videos.title: Time Twist
videos.overview: When an Alien stops at a Super-Market in earth, Garfield mistakenly enters his Space Ship and travels through different planets but it becomes hard for him to survive. The space ship and the alien are very similar to Doc Brown and the Flying DeLorean Time Machine from Back to the Future.

videos.title: Time Master
videos.overview: Garfield finds a Pocket watch which can stop time but panics when it breaks and time is frozen.

videos.title: Fish to Fry
videos.overview: When Jon reluctantly agrees to look after Liz's fish, Garfield can't resist eating them.

videos.title: Little Yellow Riding Hood
videos.overview: When Garfield, Jon, Odie, and Liz go on a picnic, Odie sneaks a baby wolf into the house and sends the Mom after Jon and Garfield.

videos.title: Fame Fatale
videos.overview: Garfield switches lives with a celebrity, Sir Leo, who is also Liz's cat claiming that the life of a super star is great. Sir Leo looks just like Garfield but speaks with a British accent. This is similar to Garfield: A Tail of Two Kitties.

videos.title: Virtualodeon
videos.overview: Garfield discovers a new 3-D format TV channel and ends up in the TV. Jon enlists the help of a scientist, Dr Bonkers, to help him get out. Meanwhile Garfield goes into commercials, a parade show, educational shows, cooking shows, game shows, and movies including Dr. No and Alien.

videos.title: It's a Cat's World
videos.overview: Garfield gets sucked into a parallel universe where cats act like humans and humans act like cats where he meets the human-like Garfield.

videos.title: Mailman Blues
videos.overview: Garfield torments Mailman Stu while Herman's on vacation in Hawaii.

videos.title: Extreme Housebreaking
videos.overview: Garfield is enrolled on the Dr. Whipple's Pet obedience course after Jon secretly tapes him misbehaving, but Garfield eventually discovers the doctor as a sham artist fraudulently using his course to launder money for himself; the doctor is then ruined when Garfield sneaks a microphone backstage as the Doctor says the public is stupid.

videos.title: Heir Apparent
videos.overview: Jon and Doc Boy might inherit their cousin's haunted estate but to take custody must stay there longer than the other.

videos.title: From the Oven
videos.overview: Jon is watching a cooking show to make Odie's birthday cake when Jon accidently switched the channel, leaving Jon to mistake the directions from the horror movie as being from the cooking show. It becomes a Frankenstein-like monster cake.

videos.title: Caroling Capers
videos.overview: After hearing children go door to door singing carols on TV, Garfield tries to go around singing carols for food, but all of his attempts are futile.

videos.title: Neighbor Nathan
videos.overview: Odie runs away from home, sick of Garfield's cruelty towards him, but the new house he runs off to is the residence of a boy with the personality of a mad scientist named Nathan, who plans to use his new invention to transform Odie into a cockroach. Now it is up to Garfield to save Odie.

videos.title: History of Dog
videos.overview: Garfield tells us about history of dogs, but puts them in a negative light. When Odie and his dog friends save Garfield's favorite Italian restaurant from a kitchen fire, Garfield is forced to admit that even dogs aren't that stupid.

videos.title: Up a Tree
videos.overview: Odie becomes friends with the garden squirrels after he helps one recover from an accident.

videos.title: It's a Cheese World
videos.overview: Garfield tries to take Squeak and his friends to Eddie Gormand's Cheeseland, but Harry is in charge of keeping mice out.

videos.title: Nice to Nermal
videos.overview: Nermal steals Pooky after Garfield is mean to him, and Garfield must be nice to Nermal to get Pooky back.

videos.title: Out on a Limb
videos.overview: Garfield, Odie, Nermal and Jon all get stuck in a tree, so they try to get help.

videos.title: Super Me
videos.overview: Garfield imitates a superhero so that Nermal will reward him with food, but gets caught up with the real superhero and a bank robbery.

videos.title: Mastermind
videos.overview: Garfield gets a device that reads people's minds and saves the world from Pizza-Craving Aliens.

videos.title: The Amazing Flying Dog
videos.overview: Odie dreams that he's a super-dog who can fly.

videos.title: The Last Word
videos.overview: Nermal bets Garfield he can't last an hour without eating.

videos.title: Iceman
videos.overview: Garfield helps Oga, the ice cream lady, find a prehistoric mate.

videos.title: T3000
videos.overview: After the dog catchers get fired for failing to stop Garfield and Odie from robbing a Deli, Garfield helps the dog catchers defeat the robotic dog catcher.

videos.title: Home for the Holidays
videos.overview: Jon wins the lottery, but is unable to find his ticket, but when he finds it, it is revealed that it is not the winning ticket. This is Mr. Barker's first appearance.

videos.title: Ticket to Riches
videos.overview: Jon wins the lottery, but is unable to find his ticket.

videos.title: Gravity of the Situation
videos.overview: An alien from a planet with no gravity lands on earth to recharge his ship. While in Jon's house he cancels out gravity, causing household object to float around the house. This is Nimbus's second appearance, though he's been redesigned and has a higher pitched voice.

videos.title: The Art of Being Uncute
videos.overview: Eddie Gourmand is the judge for the Cutest Cat Of The Year award and decides for the new cute to be the opposite of cute, and the prize is six months in Greenland, so Garfield decides to make Nermal a mess in order to get some peace and quiet.

videos.title: Night of the Bunny Slippers
videos.overview: A pair of bunny slippers comes to life, and everyone must join forces to defeat them. This is Aunt Ivy's first appearance.

videos.title: Blasteroid
videos.overview: The Aliens previously seen in "Pasta Wars" send an asteroid made of meatballs to destroy Earth, Garfield and Odie reluctantly travel in a spaceship to stop the Blasteroid.

videos.title: The Big Sneeze
videos.overview: Jon sneezes every time he is near Garfield, and his doctor explains that he must get rid of Garfield, however when Garfield does something nice for Jon, he uncovers a shocking secret: he is allergic to goldenrod.

videos.title: The Spy Who Fed Me
videos.overview: Garfield has to lose ten pounds, but Jon discovers he has been snacking between meals. Liz gives him a robot that will follow Garfield everywhere he goes to endure he sticks to his diet, but Garfield tricks Jon

videos.title: Meet Max Mouse
videos.overview: Squeak's cat-hating relative, Max, moves into Garfield's home and rallies the other mice to rebel against him. Meanwhile, Jon calls an exterminator to come rid his house of them. This is Max's first appearance.

videos.title: The Haunted House
videos.overview: Jon spends the day in a vacation house to come up with a comic book idea. The only trouble is, the house is haunted.

videos.title: Which Witch?
videos.overview: The twins, Dresilla and Minerva, come to visit, and end up like Hansel and Gretal in an evil witch's lair.

videos.title: Cyber Mailman
videos.overview: The scientist Dr Bonkers creates a cyber mail man to deliver the post but some taco sauce falls into the central computer, making the cyber mail man deliver the next days news paper. Jon sees this as an opportunity to make money, using tomorrow's lottery numbers also printed in the paper. This episode has a parody of The Twilight Zone.

videos.title: Odie for Sale
videos.overview: Jon is in debt, and decides he must sell some of his possessions to pay the bill. When Garfield puts Odie on the stall for two cents, he is bought by the person Jon is being sued by, and it is up to Garfield to get him back.

videos.title: Farm Fresh Feline
videos.overview: Jon, Garfield, and Odie visit Doc Boy on the farm. While there, Dr. Whipple hypnotizes Garfield into doing farm work.

videos.title: Dogs Day
videos.overview: After Odie helps their friend, Nimbus the space alien, he gives him a forever doggie cookie. Odie licks Jon after eating it, and Jon starts acting like a dog. Then Jon licks Liz and the condition spreads.

videos.title: Planet of Poultry
videos.overview: Aliens from another planet plan to turn all the earth creatures into chickens. This is the first appearance of Vito's pizza boy.

videos.title: With Four You Get Pizza
videos.overview: Jon goes out on a date with Liz to Vito's Pizzaria and Garfield wants to go along, but Vito banned animals from entering the restaurant. So Garfield and Odie disguise themselves as Jon's "daughters" to get into Vito's, but Jon and Liz's date turns into disaster.

videos.title: The Bluebird of Happiness
videos.overview: One of the baby bluebirds from "Mother Garfield" return and Garfield saves him from Harry. But Nermal accidentally lets Harry have it and Garfield, Nermal, and Odie must save it.

videos.title: Inside Eddie Gourmand
videos.overview: After Eddie Gourmand gives a bad review about Vito's Pizzaria on TV, Jon, Garfield, and Odie go see him to find out why he's so cranky lately and help him reunite with his mother.

videos.title: Fido Food Feline
videos.overview: After eating dogfood, Garfield is convinced he's turning into a dog.

videos.title: Everything's Relative
videos.overview: Aunt Ivy's house is being rid of mice and she has to stay at Jon's home for a week. Then, Drusilla and Minerva show up, and Jon is so annoyed with them that he tries to get them to stay at Doc Boy's farm. But Doc Boy doesn't want to put up with them either. This is Aunt Esther, Lucretia, and Tabitha's first appearance.

videos.title: Honey, I Shrunk the Pets
videos.overview: Nathan returns and shrinks Garfield with his shrink ray, and Garfield must find a way to return to normal size.

videos.title: Garfield Astray
videos.overview: After Garfield plays a mean trick on Nermal, a bowling ball falls on his head and loses his memory. Then, Nermal tricks Garfield into thinking he's a stray cat named Ichabod. Then Garfield meets a couple of stray cats named Tino and Gino. This is Tino and Gino's first appearance.

videos.title: History of Cats
videos.overview: Garfield tells a small yet untrue history about his own species, and the mice are upset because Garfield is making it seem as though cats actually did everything in history.

videos.title: Black Cat Blues
videos.overview: A miserable, black cat named Jonah passes by Garfield outside, and Garfield is given a curse and has bad luck all the time. Garfield must figure out how to lift the curse.

videos.title: Cuter Than Cute
videos.overview: Nermal comes over for a visit and the space lasagna return once again and send a spy disguised as a cute kitten over to Garfield's home. The "kitten" is way cuter than Nermal, and Nermal gets jealous.

videos.title: Great Pizza Race
videos.overview: Jon goes out on a big date with Liz and orders Garfield a pizza for dinner from Vito's Pizzaria. Garfield uses a tape recorder to record Jon's ordering the pizza, and uses it to get free pizza and, also, to harass Vito.

videos.title: Master Chef
videos.overview: After a failed microwave lasagna, Jon takes the pets to their favorite pizzeria. Vito waves their praise, claiming his mentor Giuseppe Cuistone makes the world's best lasagna but disappeared years ago. Through chattering mice, Garfield tracks him down and won't rest until he can taste the ultimate Italian delicacy. the results are striking for them, Vito and Jon.

videos.title: The Guest from Beyond
videos.overview: Eddie Gourmand, a food critic, is fired from his show only to be replaced by his station manager who wants to promote a healthier way of cooking. After a chance meeting in a movie theater, Jon invites him back to his house for dinner. But when Eddie injures his foot because of Garfield, he has to stay at Jon’s and orders him to take care of him until he is healed or else he’ll sue.

videos.title: Depths of a Salesman
videos.overview: Jon keeps buying useless things on the All-Buying-Stuff Channel.

videos.title: Land of Hold
videos.overview: Jon calls the cable company, but has no luck getting anyone on the line.

videos.title: Penny Henny
videos.overview: Garfield flees to avoid being handled by Minerva and Drusilla, so Jon tells the girls a story.

videos.title: A Gripping Tale
videos.overview: Odie gets captured by a giant squid in the sewer and Garfield attempts to rescue him

videos.title: Wicked Wishes
videos.overview: Jon, Garfield and Odie unleash a very bad genie.

videos.title: Jumbo Shrimpy
videos.overview: Dr. Whipple has a new patient: an elephant named Shrimpy.

videos.title: Pirate Gold
videos.overview: It's a rainy day, perfect for watching pirate movies.

videos.title: Me, Garfield, and I
videos.overview: When Garfield sees a news report a cloning device, het gets a not-so-brilliant idea.

videos.title: Detective Odie
videos.overview: Packy has a very strange habit: he likes to swap things that don't belong to him!

videos.title: Stealing Home
videos.overview: Bruno takes over the house when Jon goes away on a trip.

videos.title: Full of Beans
videos.overview: Odie accidently swallows a mexican jumping bean

videos.title: Love and Lasagna
videos.overview: Vito is sad after Angeluca broke up with him.

videos.title: True Colors
videos.overview: The TV in the living room needs to be fixed. While it is away Jon brings out his old TV. Jon shows Garfield a show he used to like when he was a kid. Garfield watches the show, but he keeps complaining because there is no color. The TV shockingly speaks back and takes away Garfield's colors until he becomes nice enough to get them back. After he has done his good deeds he goes back to the house and finds the the TV is back and the old one is put back in storage. Garfield is glad he did good deeds and returns to watching colored television.

videos.title: Mind Over Mouse
videos.overview: Squeak has developed the power to foresee the future.

videos.title: The Big Sleep
videos.overview: Some squirrels have pilfered Garfield's snack.

videos.title: Pampered Pussycat
videos.overview: Garfield and Odie meet Prince Orloff, the pampered cat of the wealthy Mrs. Van Gelt.

videos.title: Parrot Blues
videos.overview: Odie is at Doc Boy's, so Jon brings in another pet to keep Garfield company.

videos.title: Rain or Shine
videos.overview: When Jon and Liz go on vacation, Garfield and Odie stay with Aunt Ivy.

videos.title: The Mole Express
videos.overview: A mole is digging beneath Jon's yard and ruins their barbecue.

videos.title: Unfair Weather
videos.overview: Jon watches Mr. Barker's parrot, Paxton, while he is away. However, Paxton flies downtown telling people things that cause all of them to burst into tears.

videos.title: Furry Tales
videos.overview: Garfield tells Odie a fairy tale about a prince.

videos.title: Kind to Kittens
videos.overview: In between home-made burritos and Vito's pizzas, Garfield continues telling the story of Prince Jon and fair Elizabeth to a captivated Odie.

videos.title: Prehistoric Pup
videos.overview: After a meteorite lands, it turns Odie into a prehistoric dog.

videos.title: Land of Later
videos.overview: A group of inhabitants who live underground turn everbody into procrastinators.

videos.title: Laugh in a Can
videos.overview: The network adds a laugh track to Garfield's show, much to his chagrin.

videos.title: The Non-Garfield Show
videos.overview: Jon pitches an idea for a TV show to a successful producer.

videos.title: The Caped Avenger Rides Again!
videos.overview: Garfield solves a mystery of who stole a rare comic book.

videos.title: The Superhero Apprentice
videos.overview: Nermal becomes a supervillain to get revenge on Garfield's Caped Avenger routine.

videos.title: Teddy Dearest
videos.overview: Jon sells Pooky as a new toy to Mr. Allwork.

videos.title: Bath Day
videos.overview: Garfield, Odie, and Nermal have a fantasy while in the bathtub.

videos.title: What a Difference a Pet Makes
videos.overview: Garfield answers fan mail sent in asking about pets.

videos.title: Garfield Gets Canned
videos.overview: Garfield tries to open a can of food while Jon is away for a while.

videos.title: Partners in Mime
videos.overview: Jon takes part in a competition for mimes.

videos.title: Boris the Snowman
videos.overview: While vacationing, Garfield encounters a couple of snowmen who come to life.

videos.title: Long Lost Lyman
videos.overview: Jon, Garfield, and Odie go in search of their friend Lyman.

videos.title: The Golden Lasagna Awards
videos.overview: The first annual Golden Lasagna Awards Show on television! Oh, my! Nermal hasn't won that trophy yet, has he?

videos.title: Pawparazzi
videos.overview: Garfield Cat wins Brandon Scoop's show Positively Perfect Pussycat Pageant! Er...no....that's a mistake says judge Mary Margaret Freen.

videos.title: It's About Time
videos.overview: How could Garfield be possibly jealous of adorable Nermal? Nermal doesn't even have his own show!

videos.title: Online Arbuckle
videos.overview: Missing his mug by inches and pouring boiling hot coffee on his laps, ending up on all fours with a painting on his head, Jon is so clumsy!

videos.title: Muscle Mouse
videos.overview: Jon is so grateful to Garfield for keeping mice away from the house!

videos.title: The Write Stuff
videos.overview: Jon in prison! Liz marries Eddie Gourmand! Garfield adopts Nermal! Well, Samuel W. Underburger certainly doesn't do comedy.

videos.title: Cupid Cat
videos.overview: Doc Boy, Jon's brother, is working incredibly hard on his farm. Jon tries to help him find a companion.

videos.title: The Control Freak
videos.overview: Nathan tests a out device that can control people's minds.

videos.title: Every Witch Way
videos.overview: Mrs. Cauldron's niece wants to marry Jon.

videos.title: Revenge of the Cat People
videos.overview: Neferkitty (or Fuzzbutton) turns everybody in town to stone.

videos.title: The Garfield-Only Show
videos.overview: All the characters are leaving the show, vexed as they are for not getting more lines. No problem!

videos.title: Filthy Figitives
videos.overview: Garfield decides to fire all the other characters.

videos.title: Smartest Dog in the World
videos.overview: Doc Boy takes his farm animals to Jon's house for him to look after.

videos.title: Farmer Garfield
videos.overview: If only Doc Boy would go on holidays with her! Gloria insists so much on him finding a replacement on the farm.

videos.title: More than Meets the Eye
videos.overview: Mrs. Cauldron casts a spell on Odie that makes him smarter.

videos.title: Fast Friends
videos.overview: Garfield tries to become faster than Mrs. Ferret.

videos.title: Where's Odie
videos.overview: Jon gives out a cash reward to whoever gives Garfield and Odie a bath.

videos.title: Doggone Jon
videos.overview: Al is a hopeless dogcatcher and Mr. Kennel, his boss, might not even give him his other chance to actually catch a dog.

videos.title: The Mysterious Machine
videos.overview: Nathan tests out a device that can make one invisible.

videos.title: Fitness Crazed
videos.overview: Biff won't make a sportsman out of Garfield but Garfield can certainly make a greedy idler out of Biff!

videos.title: Little Trouble in Big China
videos.overview: Garfield absolutely needs to mail Nermal to China this time or the most awesomely adorable kitten will spend the whole summer with him!

videos.title: My Friend, Nermal
videos.overview: Cute Nermal's life is at stake! Mean-looking Crusher, Doberman and Rottweiler are chasing him down when Garfield comes and saves him!

videos.title: Take a Ferret to Lunch
videos.overview: Liz finds it ever so difficult to get a new owner for Mrs. Ferret. But then again, who would like to have a pet that only eats and sleeps?

videos.title: Bride and Broom
videos.overview: Garfield-Duck has to wait for Winona's duck spell to wear off! But why did she cast a spell on him?

videos.title: Problems, Problems, Problems
videos.overview: Garfield the Wise is overbooked! Everyone is literally begging him for help.

videos.title: Two Times the Trouble
videos.overview: Alert! The pest alarm is ringing! Garfield checks the alarm screen: Drusilla and Minerva are at the door!

videos.title: The Great Trade-Off
videos.overview: Dr. Puzzle has invented an ingenious device to trade two people's personalities!
